This video exposes how Satanism crept into hip hop and mainstream music. Pastor Craig Lewis @PRDirector1 (EX Ministries, The Truth Behind Hip Hop) even warned before 1993 that the Holy Spirit showed him satanic themes were about to enter rap culture. Not long after, he witnessed it on TV — an artist boldly cutting “666” into his hairstyle.

Fast forward to today, and Satan doesn’t even have to hide. Occult themes are everywhere: rap, pop, country, metal, Hollywood — all glorifying rebellion, self-worship, and “do what thou wilt.” Meanwhile, many Christians keep making excuses to keep indulging in secular music.

But the Bible is clear: “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world.” (Ephesians 6:12)
It’s time to stop entertaining darkness and start guarding our homes, our ears, and our souls. 

Jesus is coming soon — will you be ready?
